backups.restoreWarning: Warning: No additional backup archive will be created. Before overwriting data, the system creates a temporary recovery point for the database and, when included in the backup, the app storage. If an error occurs, the previous state is restored automatically; if the rollback or safe cleanup of the recovery points cannot be fully confirmed, the system remains locked. After a successful restore, returning to another state requires restoring a different backup, such as a newer one. Existing backup archives are never overwritten. Enter WIEDERHERSTELLEN to continue.
